site.name: Aetna Mine
site.location: Carbonate Hill, Leadville Mining District, Lake County
overview: Aetna Mine is a documented historic underground mine on Carbonate Hill in the Leadville mining district. The USGS Mineral Resources Data System records an ore-body reference point near 39.24471, -106.28144 and classifies the patented property as a past producer with zinc recorded as a commodity.

timeline.event: A Leadville newspaper retrospective identified the Aetna among lodes on the southwestern part of Carbonate Hill.
The U.S. Geological Survey's Professional Paper 148 documented the geology and ore deposits of the Leadville district; that report is retained in the later federal mine record's bibliography.
The U.S. Bureau of Mines reported the Aetna record that was later updated within the USGS Mineral Resources Data System.

moreHistory: The reviewed evidence consistently places the Aetna in the Leadville district on Carbonate Hill, not at Longfellow Gulch. The federal mine record identifies an underground, patented, past-producing property and supplies a specific ore-body coordinate.

Available desk sources do not establish a dependable production total, operator chronology, detailed workings description, or present condition. The mapped point is a historic site-level reference and should not be treated as a surveyed safe or accessible opening.
